question: What is GPT-5, released by OpenAI in 2025, and what were its main new features?
text:
**GPT‑5 is an AI model family that OpenAI released on August 7, 2025.** It became the default in ChatGPT at launch. Its biggest change was that ChatGPT could automatically choose between a fast model for everyday questions and a deeper reasoning model, **GPT‑5 Thinking**, for harder tasks. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/?KBOpenTab=undefined&utm_source=openai))

Its main improvements were:

- **Better coding and tool use.** GPT‑5 was better at writing and debugging code, working with existing codebases, and using tools across multi-step tasks. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-for-developers/?utm_source=openai))
- **Stronger reasoning and image understanding.** It improved on tasks involving math, science, and visual inputs such as charts and diagrams. It also improved at writing and following detailed instructions. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5/?KBOpenTab=undefined&utm_source=openai))
- **More reliable answers.** OpenAI reported fewer factual errors and less tendency to agree with users just to please them. It could still make mistakes. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/gpt-5-system-card/?utm_source=openai))
- **More control for developers.** The API launched with GPT‑5, GPT‑5 mini, and GPT‑5 nano, plus settings for how much reasoning the model does and how detailed its answers are. ([openai.com](https://openai.com/index/introducing-gpt-5-for-developers/?utm_source=openai))
